item.title: Atiku: Democracy Under Siege, Tinubu’s Chokehold Responsible For FCT Polls Apathy
item.description: Atiku cites low FCT poll turnout as evidence of shrinking democratic space, urges opposition unity to safeguard Nigeria’s democracy.

item.title: APC Sweeps Kano Municipal, Ungogo By-Elections
item.description: APC has clinched Kano Municipal and Ungogo seats as INEC declares Daneji, Sa’ad winners amid Kwankwasiyya claims.

item.title: APC Dominates FCT Polls, Wins Five Out Of Six Councils
item.description: APC secures five of six FCT councils, with PDP taking Gwagwalada.

item.title: Armed Man Shot Dead After Breaching Mar-a-Lago Security Perimeter, Secret Service Says
item.description: Armed intruder breaches Mar-a-Lago security, raises shotgun at agents, and is fatally shot during confrontation Sunday morning.

item.title: Trump Edges Closer To Iran Conflict As Allies Press Him To Refocus On Economy
item.description: Trump moves closer to potential Iran war as aides urge economic focus before midterm elections.

item.title: INEC Denies Migrating Voters In FCT Polls
item.description: INEC says no voters were moved, clarifies split polling units created to ease congestion during FCT elections.

item.title: Mexico’s Most Wanted Cartel Leader El Mencho Killed in Military Raid
item.description: Mexico’s most wanted cartel leader El Mencho dies after military clash, sparking coordinated cartel retaliation across multiple Mexican states.

item.title: EFCC Nabs 20, Seizes N17m Over Alleged Vote Buying In FCT Polls
item.description: EFCC operatives detain suspects across FCT for vote buying, seize over N17 million cash.

item.title: Securing Oil Assets Key To Revenue Stability, Says Niger Delta Progressive Alliance
item.description: Niger Delta Progressive Alliance says safeguarding oil and gas infrastructure remains one of the most effective strategies for strengthening national revenue.

item.title: Violence Sweeps Mexico After El Mencho Killed In Security Operation
item.description: Cartel retaliation spreads across Mexico as roadblocks burn, arrests mount and foreign governments issue security warnings.
